name: echo sunflowers
description: Proposal after Vincent van Gogh, Sunflowers (1888), 40 cell lattice (12 px cells, the creature at 2x as the vase, standing on a dark wooden table against a yellow wall with five sunflowers on green stems rising out of the top of its head, one drooping over its right arm): a small gold sun comes in on the left and crosses the top of the panel, the antenna pings, every seed disc slides toward the sun and every stem leans after it while the creature's eyes track it, the eyes shut happy while it stands overhead, one petal comes off the drooping flower and zigzags down and off the panel, a blink, and the sun goes out on the right and the flowers face front again; judge whether it reads at a glance as the painting with the creature as the vase, and whether the heads turning to the sun reads at 12 px cells.
